I can't move between the cards with the arrow keys anymore. Could you bring that back and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and the other documents in docs/ for this project's requirements.

Restored arrow-key movement between cards, including edge stops and the remembered tab position. Movement leaves game state unchanged, and modified arrow keys remain with the browser.

Validation passed: type checking, all 138 unit tests, and all 76 browser checks on the project’s named runtime. The repository-wide formatting check reports 13 pre-existing files outside this change.
